title: Zscaler customer notifications: Trust Portal subscriptions, Admin Console contacts and the Service Continuity notification protocol

prose.label: Notification protocol.
prose.text: {{protocol-upgrades}} {{protocol-updates-incidents}} {{policy-scope}} The EOS and EOL policy itself is in [[portfolio.usage-terms.eos-eol-policy]]. The table's cell layout and spelling are open {{gap:protocol-table-reading}}. Whether notification preferences have an API or Terraform object is open {{gap:notification-api-object}}.

trust-portal.statement: The Zscaler Trust Portal at https://trust.zscaler.com shows cloud operation status, upcoming maintenance and security updates, with access to 90 days of historical data.

quotes: You can go to the Zscaler Trust Portal at https://trust.zscaler.com to view insights into cloud operation status, upcoming maintenance, and security updates.
You also have access to 90 days of historical data.

trust-subscription-scope.statement: The Trust Portal subscription service gives granular control over which data centers and services updates are received for, and a mailing list can be added; a group email entered under Group Settings receives the same subscriptions as the account holder.

quotes: The subscription service gives you granular control over which data centers and services you want to receive updates for and the ability to add a mailing list to receive the updates.
Under the Group Settings section, enter your group email.
Your group receives the same subscriptions based on your subscriptions.

trust-subscriptions-page.statement: On the Trust Portal Subscriptions page, subscriptions are managed per cloud: Scheduled and Completed maintenance, In Progress and Resolved advisory notifications, core cloud services (all or selected) and data centers (all or selected).

quotes: Select the cloud you want to manage subscriptions for.
Subscribe to Scheduled and Completed maintenance notifications.
Subscribe to In Progress and Resolved advisory notifications.
Subscribe to notifications for All core cloud services, or select which core cloud services you want to subscribe to.
Subscribe to All data centers, or select which data centers you want to subscribe to.

admin-console-contacts.statement: Zscaler sends Security Updates, Service Updates and Product Updates to the Technical and Business contacts on the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization > Contacts).

quotes: Zscaler also sends the following notifications to the Technical and Business contacts listed on the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization > Contacts) in the Zscaler Admin Console:
Security Updates: Latest information on vulnerabilities and threats that might affect your organization.
Service Updates: New service and product enhancements, including new data center notifications and cloud release information.
Product Updates: Communication regarding important changes and updates to our service.

contacts-group-email.statement: A group email address can be entered as a notification contact to reach a whole team, and an admin can be subscribed to these updates when the admin is added or edited.

quotes: You can enter a group email address to send the notification to an entire team instead of an individual.
an admin can be subscribed to these updates when adding or editing an admin.

protocol-upgrades.statement: In the Service Continuity Customer Notification Protocol table, a Service Upgrade (typically every 3-6 months) is posted on Trust at least 24 hours ahead and emailed at least 7 days ahead; an Infrastructure Upgrade (monthly, customer-visible data center and IP address additions or removals) is posted at least 24 hours ahead and emailed at least 60 days ahead; Secrets Management (quarterly SAML Certificate Update) is posted and emailed at least 2 weeks ahead.

quotes: | Change Type | Typical Frequency | Summary | Notice On Trust | Email Notification |
Service Upgrade | 3–6 Months | New platform capabilities and enhancements | Yes (minimum 24 hours prior) | Yes (minimum 7 days prior)
Infrastructure Upgrade | Monthly | Customer-visible additions or removals of data centers and IP addresses | Yes (minimum 24 hours prior) | Yes (minimum 60 days prior)
Secrets Management | Quarterly | SAML Certificate Update | Yes (minimum 2 weeks prior) | Yes (minimum 2 weeks prior)

protocol-updates-incidents.statement: In the same table, Security Update (continuous, real-time threat updates) has no Trust notice and no email; Service Update (weekly) follows the standard published maintenance window with no email; Infrastructure Update (weekly, no customer-visible IP address addition or removal) is posted on Trust at least 24 hours ahead with no email; a Service Incident is posted on Trust during the incident period with no email.

quotes: | Change Type | Typical Frequency | Summary | Notice On Trust | Email Notification |
Security Update | Continous | Real-time threat updates to the cloud | No | No
Service Update | Weekly | Cloud optimizations, feature enablement, and service tuning | Standard published maintenance window | No
Infrastructure Update | Weekly | Data center and network maintenance. No customer-visible IP address addition or removal. | Yes (minimum 24 hours prior) | No
Service Incident | N/A | Imminent or occurring service issue impacting multiple customers | Yes (during incident period) | No

policy-scope.statement: Zscaler's Service Continuity Policy governs how and when changes are made to its services, and the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) Policy is separate from it.

quotes: Zscaler's Service Continuity Policy governs how and when we make changes to our services.
Our End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) Policy is separate from our Service Continuity Policy.

protocol-table-reading.title: How the notification protocol table's Planned and Unplanned rows read
protocol-table-reading.detail: The table header has five columns, but the Planned and Unplanned rows begin with an extra group label cell, so the Notice On Trust and Email Notification reading for those rows is by position. The page spells Security Update's frequency "Continous", gives "Standard published maintenance window" as a notice cell without a lead time, and gives no lead time for Service Incident email ("No").

notification-api-object.title: Whether notification preferences have an API or Terraform object
notification-api-object.detail: The captured page does not say whether notification preferences have an API or Terraform object.
